text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I just... I can't believe it...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I beat Tamtam and Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Gosh! You're praising me way too much!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I'm really glad that I could finish
things like
this.

text_block_list.name: Racecourse Staff Member A
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek, it's time for your post-race

interview. This way, please!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um... Thank you very much for coming to
our race
today.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
My cheekiness has caused my trainer a
lot of
trouble over the past year.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
But I believe that those trials have
helped us both
to grow.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Super Creek, what's your next goal?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Umm, I'll have to discuss that with my
trainer, but
I'd love to try for the Osaka
Hai.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
We still have a lot to learn, but we hope
you'll all
be here to support us next year
as well.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: The heck's with all the ceremony?!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Geez, I can't stand it. Ya feel me, Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
But I s'pose we can give her this one.
The real
battle is only just beginnin'.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Don't you say it. I don't wanna hear
nothin'
about you bein' hungry, 'kay?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even amidst the year-end chaos, Super
Creek has
the best day ever.
